verses.original: Συνίστημι δὲ ὑμῖν Φοίβην τὴν ἀδελφὴν ἡμῶν οὖσαν καὶ διάκονον τῆς ἐκκλησίας τῆς ἐν Κενχρεαῖς
verses.transliteration: Synistēmi de hymin Phoibēn tēn adelphēn hēmōn ousan kai diakonon tēs ekklēsias tēs en Kenchreais
verses.literal: I commend to you our sister Phoebe - a servant of the church in Cenchrea
verses.literalPt: RECOMENDO-VOS, pois, Febe, nossa irmã, a qual serve na igreja que está em Cencréia,

verses.original: ἵνα αὐτὴν προσδέξησθε ἐν Κυρίῳ ἀξίως τῶν ἁγίων καὶ παραστῆτε αὐτῇ ἐν ᾧ ἂν ὑμῶν χρῄζῃ πράγματι καὶ γὰρ αὐτὴ προστάτις πολλῶν ἐγενήθη καὶ ἐμοῦ αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: hina autēn prosdexēsthe en Kyriō axiōs tōn hagiōn kai parastēte autē en hō an hymōn chrēzē pragmati kai gar autē prostatis pollōn egenēthē kai emou autou
verses.literal: Welcome her in the Lord in a manner worthy of the saints and assist her with anything . . . . . . she may need from you For she has been a great help to many people including me . . .
verses.literalPt: Para que a recebais no Senhor, como convém aos santos, e a ajudeis em qualquer coisa que de vós necessitar; porque tem hospedado a muitos, como também a mim mesmo.

verses.original: Ἀσπάσασθε Πρίσκαν καὶ Ἀκύλαν τοὺς συνεργούς μου ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: Aspasasthe Priskan kai Akylan tous synergous mou en Christō Iēsou
verses.literal: Greet Prisca and Aquila my fellow workers in Christ Jesus
verses.literalPt: Saudai a Priscila e a Áqüila, meus cooperadores em Cristo Jesus,

verses.original: οἵτινες ὑπὲρ τῆς ψυχῆς μου τὸν ἑαυτῶν τράχηλον ὑπέθηκαν οἷς οὐκ ἐγὼ μόνος εὐχαριστῶ ἀλλὰ καὶ πᾶσαι αἱ ἐκκλησίαι τῶν ἐθνῶν
verses.transliteration: hoitines hyper tēs psychēs mou ton heautōn trachēlon hypethēkan hois ouk egō monos eucharistō alla kai pasai hai ekklēsiai tōn ethnōn
verses.literal: who have risked their lives for me . . . . . . Not only I but all the churches of the Gentiles are grateful to them
verses.literalPt: Os quais pela minha vida expuseram as suas cabeças; o que não só eu lhes agradeço, mas também todas as igrejas dos gentios.

verses.original: καὶ τὴν κατ’ οἶκον αὐτῶν ἐκκλησίαν Ἀσπάσασθε Ἐπαίνετον τὸν ἀγαπητόν μου ὅς ἐστιν ἀπαρχὴ τῆς Ἀσίας εἰς Χριστόν
verses.transliteration: kai tēn kat’ oikon autōn ekklēsian Aspasasthe Epaineton ton agapēton mou hos estin aparchē tēs Asias eis Christon
verses.literal: Greet also the church that meets at their house Greet my beloved Epenetus who was the first convert to Christ in the province of Asia
verses.literalPt: Saudai também a igreja que está em sua casa. Saudai a Epêneto, meu amado, que é as primícias da Acaia em Cristo.

verses.original: Ἀσπάσασθε Μαριάν ἥτις πολλὰ ἐκοπίασεν εἰς ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: Aspasasthe Marian hētis polla ekopiasen eis hymas
verses.literal: Greet Mary who has worked very hard for you
verses.literalPt: Saudai a Maria, que trabalhou muito por nós.

verses.original: Ἀσπάσασθε Ἀνδρόνικον καὶ Ἰουνίαν τοὺς συγγενεῖς μου καὶ συναιχμαλώτους μου οἵτινές εἰσιν ἐπίσημοι ἐν τοῖς ἀποστόλοις οἳ καὶ πρὸ ἐμοῦ γέγοναν ἐν Χριστῷ
verses.transliteration: Aspasasthe Andronikon kai Iounian tous syngeneis mou kai synaichmalōtous mou hoitines eisin episēmoi en tois apostolois hoi kai pro emou gegonan en Christō
verses.literal: Greet Andronicus and Junia my fellow countrymen and fellow prisoners They are outstanding among the apostles and they were in Christ before I was
verses.literalPt: Saudai a Andrônico e a Júnias, meus parentes e meus companheiros na prisão, os quais se distinguiram entre os apóstolos e que foram antes de mim em Cristo.

verses.original: Ἀσπάσασθε Ἀμπλιᾶτον τὸν ἀγαπητόν μου ἐν Κυρίῳ
verses.transliteration: Aspasasthe Ampliaton ton agapēton mou en Kyriō
verses.literal: Greet Ampliatus my beloved in the Lord
verses.literalPt: Saudai a Amplias, meu amado no SENHOR.

verses.original: Ἀσπάσασθε Οὐρβανὸν τὸν συνεργὸν ἡμῶν ἐν Χριστῷ καὶ Στάχυν τὸν ἀγαπητόν μου
verses.transliteration: Aspasasthe Ourbanon ton synergon hēmōn en Christō kai Stachyn ton agapēton mou
verses.literal: Greet Urbanus our fellow worker in Christ and my beloved Stachys
verses.literalPt: Saudai a Urbano, nosso cooperador em Cristo, e a Estáquis, meu amado.

verses.original: Ἀσπάσασθε Ἀπελλῆν τὸν δόκιμον ἐν Χριστῷ Ἀσπάσασθε τοὺς ἐκ τῶν Ἀριστοβούλου
verses.transliteration: Aspasasthe Apellēn ton dokimon en Christō Aspasasthe tous ek tōn Aristoboulou
verses.literal: Greet Apelles who is approved in Christ Greet those who belong to the household of Aristobulus
verses.literalPt: Saudai a Apeles, aprovado em Cristo. Saudai aos da família de Aristóbulo.

verses.original: Ἀσπάσασθε Ἡρῳδίωνα τὸν συγγενῆ μου Ἀσπάσασθε τοὺς ἐκ τῶν Ναρκίσσου τοὺς ὄντας ἐν Κυρίῳ
verses.transliteration: Aspasasthe Hērōdiōna ton syngenē mou Aspasasthe tous ek tōn Narkissou tous ontas en Kyriō
verses.literal: Greet Herodion my fellow countryman Greet those from the household of Narcissus who are in the Lord
verses.literalPt: Saudai a Herodião, meu parente. Saudai aos da família de Narciso, os que estão no SENHOR.

verses.original: Ἀσπάσασθε Τρύφαιναν καὶ Τρυφῶσαν τὰς κοπιώσας ἐν Κυρίῳ Ἀσπάσασθε Περσίδα τὴν ἀγαπητήν ἥτις πολλὰ ἐκοπίασεν ἐν Κυρίῳ
verses.transliteration: Aspasasthe Tryphainan kai Tryphōsan tas kopiōsas en Kyriō Aspasasthe Persida tēn agapētēn hētis polla ekopiasen en Kyriō
verses.literal: Greet Tryphena and Tryphosa women who have worked hard in the Lord Greet my beloved Persis who has worked very hard in the Lord
verses.literalPt: Saudai a Trifena e a Trifosa, as quais trabalham no Senhor. Saudai à amada Pérside, a qual muito trabalhou no SENHOR.

verses.original: Ἀσπάσασθε Ῥοῦφον τὸν ἐκλεκτὸν ἐν Κυρίῳ καὶ τὴν μητέρα αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐμοῦ
verses.transliteration: Aspasasthe Rhouphon ton eklekton en Kyriō kai tēn mētera autou kai emou
verses.literal: Greet Rufus chosen in the Lord and his mother who has been a mother to me as well
verses.literalPt: Saudai a Rufo, eleito no Senhor, e a sua mãe e minha.

verses.original: Ἀσπάσασθε Ἀσύνκριτον Φλέγοντα Ἑρμῆν Πατρόβαν Ἑρμᾶν καὶ τοὺς σὺν αὐτοῖς ἀδελφούς
verses.transliteration: Aspasasthe Asynkriton Phlegonta Hermēn Patroban Herman kai tous syn autois adelphous
verses.literal: Greet Asyncritus Phlegon Hermes Patrobas Hermas and the brothers with them
verses.literalPt: Saudai a Asíncrito, a Flegonte, a Hermes, a Pátrobas, a Hermas, e aos irmãos que estão com eles.

verses.original: Ἀσπάσασθε Φιλόλογον καὶ Ἰουλίαν Νηρέα καὶ τὴν ἀδελφὴν αὐτοῦ καὶ Ὀλυμπᾶν καὶ τοὺς σὺν αὐτοῖς πάντας ἁγίους
verses.transliteration: Aspasasthe Philologon kai Ioulian Nērea kai tēn adelphēn autou kai Olympan kai tous syn autois pantas hagious
verses.literal: Greet Philologus and Julia Nereus and his sister and Olympas and all the saints with them
verses.literalPt: Saudai a Filólogo e a Júlia, a Nereu e a sua irmã, e a Olimpas, e a todos os santos que com eles estão.

verses.original: Ἀσπάσασθε ἀλλήλους ἐν φιλήματι ἁγίῳ Ἀσπάζονται ὑμᾶς αἱ ἐκκλησίαι πᾶσαι τοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: Aspasasthe allēlous en philēmati hagiō Aspazontai hymas hai ekklēsiai pasai tou Christou
verses.literal: Greet one another with a holy kiss All the churches of Christ send you greetings . . .
verses.literalPt: Saudai-vos uns aos outros com santo ósculo. As igrejas de Cristo vos saúdam.

verses.original: Παρακαλῶ δὲ ὑμᾶς ἀδελφοί σκοπεῖν τοὺς τὰς διχοστασίας καὶ τὰ σκάνδαλα παρὰ τὴν διδαχὴν ἣν ὑμεῖς ἐμάθετε ποιοῦντας καὶ ἐκκλίνετε ἀπ’ αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: Parakalō de hymas adelphoi skopein tous tas dichostasias kai ta skandala para tēn didachēn hēn hymeis emathete poiountas kai ekklinete ap’ autōn
verses.literal: Now I urge you brothers to watch out for those who create divisions and obstacles that are contrary to the teaching you have learned Turn away from them
verses.literalPt: E rogo-vos, irmãos, que noteis os que promovem dissensões e escândalos contra a doutrina que aprendestes; desviai-vos deles.

verses.original: οἱ γὰρ τοιοῦτοι τῷ Κυρίῳ ἡμῶν Χριστῷ οὐ δουλεύουσιν ἀλλὰ τῇ ἑαυτῶν κοιλίᾳ καὶ διὰ τῆς χρηστολογίας καὶ εὐλογίας ἐξαπατῶσιν τὰς καρδίας τῶν ἀκάκων
verses.transliteration: hoi gar toioutoi tō Kyriō hēmōn Christō ou douleuousin alla tē heautōn koilia kai dia tēs chrēstologias kai eulogias exapatōsin tas kardias tōn akakōn
verses.literal: For such people are not serving our Lord Christ but their own appetites By smooth talk and flattery they deceive the hearts of the naive
verses.literalPt: Porque os tais não servem a nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo, mas ao seu ventre; e com suaves palavras e lisonjas enganam os corações dos simples.

verses.original: Ἡ γὰρ ὑμῶν ὑπακοὴ εἰς πάντας ἀφίκετο ἐφ’ ὑμῖν οὖν χαίρω θέλω δὲ ὑμᾶς σοφοὺς εἶναι εἰς τὸ ἀγαθόν ἀκεραίους δὲ εἰς τὸ κακόν
verses.transliteration: Hē gar hymōn hypakoē eis pantas aphiketo eph’ hymin oun chairō thelō de hymas sophous einai eis to agathon akeraious de eis to kakon
verses.literal: Everyone has heard about your obedience so I rejoice over you But I want you to be wise about what is good and innocent about what is evil
verses.literalPt: Quanto à vossa obediência, é ela conhecida de todos. Comprazo-me, pois, em vós; e quero que sejais sábios no bem, mas simples no mal.

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ Θεὸς τῆς εἰρήνης συντρίψει τὸν Σατανᾶν ὑπὸ τοὺς πόδας ὑμῶν ἐν τάχει Ἡ χάρις τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ μεθ’ ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: Ho de Theos tēs eirēnēs syntripsei ton Satanan hypo tous podas hymōn en tachei HĒ charis tou Kyriou hēmōn Iēsou Christou meth’ hymōn
verses.literal: The God of peace will soon crush Satan under your feet The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you
verses.literalPt: E o Deus de paz esmagará em breve Satanás debaixo dos vossos pés. A graça de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo seja convosco. Amém.

verses.original: Ἀσπάζεται ὑμᾶς Τιμόθεος ὁ συνεργός μου καὶ Λούκιος καὶ Ἰάσων καὶ Σωσίπατρος οἱ συγγενεῖς μου
verses.transliteration: Aspazetai hymas Timotheos ho synergos mou kai Loukios kai Iasōn kai Sōsipatros hoi syngeneis mou
verses.literal: Timothy my fellow worker sends you greetings . . . as do Lucius Jason and Sosipater my fellow countrymen
verses.literalPt: Saúdam-vos Timóteo, meu cooperador, e Lúcio, Jasom e Sosípatro, meus parentes.

verses.original: Ἀσπάζομαι ὑμᾶς ἐγὼ Τέρτιος ὁ γράψας τὴν ἐπιστολὴν ἐν Κυρίῳ
verses.transliteration: Aspazomai hymas egō Tertios ho grapsas tēn epistolēn en Kyriō
verses.literal: I Tertius who wrote down this letter greet you in the Lord
verses.literalPt: Eu, Tércio, que esta carta escrevi, vos saúdo no Senhor.

verses.original: Ἀσπάζεται ὑμᾶς Γάϊος ὁ ξένος μου καὶ ὅλης τῆς ἐκκλησίας Ἀσπάζεται ὑμᾶς Ἔραστος ὁ οἰκονόμος τῆς πόλεως καὶ Κούαρτος ὁ ἀδελφός
verses.transliteration: Aspazetai hymas Gaios ho xenos mou kai holēs tēs ekklēsias Aspazetai hymas Erastos ho oikonomos tēs poleōs kai Kouartos ho adelphos
verses.literal: Gaius who has hosted me and all the church sends you greetings . . . Erastus the city treasurer sends you greetings . . . as does our brother Quartus
verses.literalPt: Saúda-vos Gaio, meu hospedeiro, e de toda a igreja. Saúda-vos Erasto, procurador da cidade, e também o irmão Quarto.
A graça de nosso SENHOR Jesus Cristo seja com todos vós. Amém.

verses.original: Τῷ δὲ δυναμένῳ ὑμᾶς στηρίξαι κατὰ τὸ εὐαγγέλιόν μου καὶ τὸ κήρυγμα Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ κατὰ ἀποκάλυψιν μυστηρίου χρόνοις αἰωνίοις σεσιγημένου
verses.transliteration: Tō de dynamenō hymas stērixai kata to euangelion mou kai to kērygma Iēsou Christou kata apokalypsin mystēriou chronois aiōniois sesigēmenou
verses.literal: Now to Him who is able to strengthen you by my gospel and by the proclamation of Jesus Christ according to the revelation of the mystery concealed for ages past
verses.literalPt: Ora, àquele que é poderoso para vos confirmar segundo o meu evangelho e a pregação de Jesus Cristo, conforme a revelação do mistério que desde tempos eternos esteve oculto,

verses.original: φανερωθέντος δὲ νῦν διά τε γραφῶν προφητικῶν κατ’ ἐπιταγὴν τοῦ αἰωνίου Θεοῦ εἰς ὑπακοὴν πίστεως εἰς πάντα τὰ ἔθνη γνωρισθέντος
verses.transliteration: phanerōthentos de nyn dia te graphōn prophētikōn kat’ epitagēn tou aiōniou Theou eis hypakoēn pisteōs eis panta ta ethnē gnōristhentos
verses.literal: but now revealed and made known through the writings of the prophets by the command of the eternal God in order to lead all nations to the obedience that comes from faith
verses.literalPt: Mas que se manifestou agora, e se notificou pelas Escrituras dos profetas, segundo o mandamento do Deus eterno, a todas as nações para obediência da fé;

verses.original: μόνῳ σοφῷ Θεῷ διὰ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ ᾧ ἡ δόξα εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων ἀμήν
verses.transliteration: monō sophō Theō dia Iēsou Christou hō hē doxa eis tous aiōnas tōn aiōnōn amēn
verses.literal: to the only wise God be glory forever . . . . . . through Jesus Christ Amen
verses.literalPt: Ao único Deus, sábio, seja dada glória por Jesus Cristo para todo o sempre. Amém.
